summary.plain: The H.E.S.S. gamma-ray telescope array on Farm Göllschau in the Khomas Highland of Namibia: four 12 m telescopes on a 120 m square plus the large central CT5 dish.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:hess-khomas-highland. The CT1-CT4 square (120 m side, diagonal oriented north-south) is derived from the collaboration's own stated array geometry, centred on the array's official published coordinate; CT5 reuses that same coordinate as its own position ('centre of the array' per the same source).
